purpose: Every image referenced by the canonical project data. The review ZIP omits the binaries; these paths match the full project byte-for-byte, so restoring assets/ from the full export makes the review copy run unmodified.
notes: No image is embedded as base64 or a data URI anywhere in the HTML, CSS or JS — every reference is an external path.
withheld:true marks an asset that is deliberately unreachable from any public surface (roles: []).
Prototype projects 005–008 carry no real media; they resolve to generated CSS plates and therefore appear in no manifest entry.
